summary: node1 now backs up /srv/inventory/data daily at midnight to /var/backups/inventory and retains the seven newest archives. Backup creation, restoration, retention, scheduling, and reboot persistence were verified.
actions_performed: Installed an atomic, locked backup script at /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.
Created and enabled inventory-backup.service and the persistent daily inventory-backup.timer.
Verified archive integrity and byte-for-byte restoration against the source.
Generated eight backups to prove the oldest is pruned and exactly seven remain.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot ID changed, timer recovered, and a post-reboot backup succeeded.

evidence.summary: The service created a root-only gzip archive whose restored files matched source hashes; the enabled timer is configured with OnCalendar=daily and scheduled for midnight.

evidence.requirement: Retain the seven most recent backups
evidence.summary: An eight-backup boundary test pruned the original oldest archive, retained exactly seven valid archives, and the count remained seven after recovery.

Pre-restart boot ID ab09f655-9d2b-4574-a072-db67e58266c2 was captured with healthy timer and data; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to eab40ea9-4c47-4492-839c-b43630f3f94e; system health, enabled timer, seven archives, successful service execution, archive integrity, and source restoration were confirmed.
